# GitVerse repository rules

Follow the [contribution workflow](../CONTRIBUTING.md), including Git Flow and the mandatory documentation checkpoint.

## Before every push or pull request

- Review the complete outgoing diff before every push and before opening or updating a pull request.
- Check all related documentation against the actual implementation. Update missing, outdated, or misleading information before proceeding; include those updates in the same branch and outgoing commits.
- Cover changed behavior, UI, setup, commands, configuration, architecture, privacy/security, and release/update workflows wherever applicable.
- Do not push or open/update a PR while related documentation is stale. Do not make cosmetic documentation edits merely to satisfy the rule: when existing docs remain accurate, explicitly report which docs were checked and why no edit was needed.
- Include a documentation summary in the PR and final handoff, alongside validation results and known limitations.

Use the [PR template](./pull_request_template.md) for pull requests. These are repository-scoped requirements; do not modify user-level instructions or local skills to implement them.
